name: Sesame Steak & Snap Pea Stir-Fry with Roasted Miso Cauliflower

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Place miso, vinegar, oil, sesame seeds, and soy sauce in a large bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp miso paste, red
3 tbsp rice vinegar
toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Add cauliflower to the bowl with the sauce and stir to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Drizzle with any remaining sauce in the bowl. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic; place in the reserved bowl.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl with the garlic, season with salt and pepper, then toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, wash and dry snap peas.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, steak, and snap peas to the pot; stir-fry until snap peas are tender and steak is just cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Cover and remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry and roasted cauliflower between plates. Enjoy!
